{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Textured wool blazer in navy (#1a233a), structured shoulder cut with a knee-length hem and a classic notched lapel.
Silk-blend blouse in cream (#f5f5dc), relaxed fit with a button-down front reaching the waistline.
Wool-trimmed trousers in charcoal (#36454f), straight-leg cut falling to the ankle with a subtle crease.
Chelsea boots in black leather (#000000), slim ankle height with elastic side panels for easy wear while walking.
This outfit is ideal for a frosty morning commute as the wool blazer and trousers provide essential warmth against the snow and road salt without feeling bulky. The cream blouse offers a soft contrast to the dark outer layers, keeping the look professional yet approachable for a casual workday walk. It strictly respects your preference against exposed skin by maintaining full coverage from shoulders to ankles while allowing you to move comfortably on foot."}
